name: zkd-shared
description: The narrow contract crossing the PLAN/EXECUTE trust boundary — idempotency, OPA client, halt conditions, ledger record shapes, and the boundary types both planes exchange. Deliberately NOT a dump of either plane's internal domain model: zkd-app keeps its own store/search/revalidate code, zkd-execute keeps its own booking-write code, and this package is only what a message crossing the boundary needs to type-check on both sides.
